ScheduleItem.title: ScheduleItem
ScheduleItem.description: A scheduled message, email, or call automation created by a user in Skedit.

channel.description: Communication channel for the scheduled item.

recipientName.description: Display name of the recipient or contact group.

recipientTarget.description: Phone number, handle, or email address of the recipient(s).

subject.description: Email subject line or schedule note title.

messageBody.description: Message payload or call reminder script.

attachmentLabel.description: Optional attachment label or media URI description.

scheduledEpochMillis.description: Next scheduled execution time in epoch milliseconds.

askBeforeSending.description: Whether to prompt the user with a confirmation before dispatching.

notifyOnComplete.description: Whether to send a notification when the schedule triggers.

status.description: Current lifecycle status of the scheduled item.

executionCount.description: Number of times this schedule has been executed.

lastExecutedEpochMillis.description: Epoch milliseconds of the most recent execution, or 0 if never run.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the schedule was created via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the schedule was last updated via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

MessageTemplate.title: MessageTemplate
MessageTemplate.description: Reusable message template with dynamic variables for rapid scheduling.

title.description: Short descriptive title of the template.

usageCount.description: Number of times the template was used.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when created via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when updated via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

RecipientGroup.title: RecipientGroup
RecipientGroup.description: Saved broadcast list or recipient group for multi-recipient scheduling.

channel.description: Target channel for this recipient group.

membersSummary.description: Formatted list of recipient names and phone numbers/emails.

memberCount.description: Number of recipients in this group.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when created via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when updated via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

/users/{userId}/schedules/{scheduleId}.description: Per-user scheduled messages, emails, and call reminders.

/users/{userId}/groups/{groupId}.description: Per-user saved recipient groups and broadcast lists.
